title: 第一卷 第19章 绝不可能第一卷 第20章 仗义执言棚户区
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 随着林寻的灵力注入，迷雾散开，坊市入口浮现。
杨芸俏生生跟在身后，不敢张望。
见两人上前，守门修士眉头一紧，抬手拦下，“凡人？什么情况？”
林寻靠上前，翻手间五十颗灵砂塞了过去。
“我带她见见世面，行个方便。”
据他所知，坊市是有凡人的，但几乎都在生活区，这些人来历很复杂。
也有修士带进去的奴婢，但多数还是由修士所生没有灵根的凡人，又不愿去凡间，最后留在了坊市，附庸他人成为奴仆。
“哦，凡人切勿冲撞了修士，不然被打杀了，巡逻队可不管。”
大汉不着痕迹的将灵砂收入囊中，挑了挑眉。
他没有多看杨芸一眼，就算是美若天仙的凡人与坊市内的女修相比，也是云泥之别。
“修士十颗灵砂，凡人二十，天黑前必须出来......规矩你知道的。”
“是，是是！”林寻满口答应，递上三十块灵砂后接过令牌，拉着杨芸跨了进去。
随着景色变幻，杨芸站在原地目瞪口呆，“夫君，这，这就是......”
修仙之说，只存在话本，这是她第一次亲眼见到书中的描述，真有人能御剑飞行。
“不要胡乱张望，免得惹怒其他修士。”林寻捏了捏杨芸手心，提醒她回神。
再次回到这里，他内心的安全感才增加了些许。
现在的修为是炼气三层，刚好卡在敛息术的上限，收敛两层境界仍旧是炼气一层，在坊市中犹如透明人。
就算是炼气三层，以他这个年纪，也不能让人高看一眼，毕竟他是白发老人。
所以想入住坊市，只能拜托符箓店老板，苏巧巧。
到时候安定下来，就能再求大道！
符箓店。
林寻带上杨芸，低着头一路到了此处，店门口依然人很少。
“苏店主。”
“林大哥？！真的是你！”苏巧巧昏昏欲睡的眼睛，顿时明亮起来。
“你没事真的是太好了！你不知道，上次坊市外盘踞着一名劫修，专门劫杀从坊市外出的修士，我知道后急忙去找你，但你已经离开，担心死我了......”
她满脸激动，倒豆子般絮叨起来。
林寻面色一穆，“果然如此。”
原本就有猜测，现在得到证实，更让他心惊肉跳。
能当劫修的必定有两把刷子，也不知道上次为什么放过他，但这是万幸。
“那现在的情况如何？那劫修去了何处？”
苏巧巧笑道，“林大哥，不用担心，那劫修不过炼气七层，坊市的巡逻队也不是盖的，已擒杀此僚。”
“那就好，那就好。”林寻松了口气。
content_en:
With the injection of Lin Xun's spiritual power, the fog dispersed, and the entrance to Fangshi emerged.
Yang Yunqiao followed closely behind her, not daring to look around.
Seeing the two people coming forward, the gatekeeper monk frowned and raised his hand to stop him, "Mortal? What's the situation?"
Lin Xun stepped forward and stuffed fifty spiritual sands in his hands.
"I'll take her to see the world, just for convenience."
As far as he knew, there were mortals in Fang City, but almost all of them were in the living area. The origins of these people were very complicated.
There were also slaves brought in by monks, but most of them were mortals born by monks without spiritual roots. They did not want to go to the mortal world, so they ended up staying in Fangshi and becoming slaves to others.
"Oh, mortals must not collide with the monks, otherwise they will be killed. The patrol team will not care."
The big man put the spiritual sand into his bag without leaving a trace and raised his eyebrows.
He didn't take another look at Yang Yun. Even a mortal who was as beautiful as a fairy was completely different from the female cultivators in the city.
"Ten spiritual sand for monks and twenty for mortals. You must come out before dark...you know the rules."
"Yes, yes!" Lin Xun agreed, handed over thirty pieces of spiritual sand, took the token, and pulled Yang Yun in.
As the scenery changed, Yang Yun stood there dumbfounded, "Husband, this, this is..."
The theory of cultivating immortals only exists in story books. This is the first time she has seen the description in the book with her own eyes. There are real people who can fly with swords.
"Don't look around randomly, so as not to anger other monks." Lin Xun pinched Yang Yun's palm to remind her to come back to her senses.
After returning here again, his inner sense of security increased a little.
The current level of cultivation is at the third level of Qi refining, which is just stuck at the upper limit of the breath gathering technique. The two levels of converging are still at the first level of Qi refining, and he is like a transparent person in the market.
Even if he is at the third level of Qi Refining, at his age, he cannot be looked down upon by others. After all, he is a white-haired old man.
So if you want to stay in Fangshi, you can only ask the owner of the Talisman Shop, Su Qiaoqiao.
When the time comes to settle down, you can seek the road again!
Talisman shop.
Lin Xun took Yang Yun with him and walked all the way here with his head lowered. There were still very few people in front of the store.
"Shopkeeper Su."
"Brother Lin?! It's really you!" Su Qiaoqiao's sleepy eyes suddenly brightened.
"It's great that you're okay! You don't know that last time there was a robbery cultivator outside Fang City who specialized in robbing and killing monks who went out from Fang City. When I found out, I hurriedly went to find you, but you had already left. I was worried to death..."
Her face was filled with excitement and she began to chatter like she was pouring beans.
Lin Xun's expression turned grave, "As expected."
There had been speculations at first, but now it was confirmed, which made him even more frightened.
Anyone who can be a calamity cultivator must have two brushes. I don’t know why I let him go last time, but this is a blessing.
"So what's the current situation? Where did the robbery cultivator go?"
Su Qiaoqiao smiled and said, "Brother Lin, don't worry, that robbery can't reach the seventh level of Qi Refining, and Fangshi's patrol team has already captured and killed this officer."
"That's good, that's good." Lin Xun breathed a sigh of relief.
